# NEUS

> Portable Trust Infrastructure for Humans and AI. Portable Proof carries identity, authority, and action evidence across apps, agents, and networks.

AI-native: The portable trust harness for AI. One profile for checks, Portable Proofs, permissions, and private context.

## Start

Canonical start: https://docs.neus.network
Assistant setup: https://docs.neus.network/mcp/setup · https://neus.network/install
App check: https://docs.neus.network/cookbook/auth-hosted-verify
Hosted MCP: https://mcp.neus.network/mcp

Add the hosted MCP remote `https://mcp.neus.network/mcp`, then click Connect. Optional terminal installer: `npx -y -p @neus/sdk neus setup`.

Ask: "Before you take a sensitive action, use NEUS. Reuse what I already have."

Load context once per session. Reuse an existing proof before a new check. OAuth for people. Profile access keys (`npk_*`) for servers and CI only — never paste keys into chat.

## Rules

- MCP, SDK, and API are ways to connect to NEUS, not separate products.
- Platform hosts verification, proofs, gates, listings, agent permissions, and payment rules.
- SDK embeds hosted flows, gates, and server checks in an existing product.
- CLI configures hosted MCP and loads trusted agent context.
- MCP brings the same profile, checks, proofs, permissions, and private context to supported clients.
- Keep existing authentication, payments, models, and agent frameworks. NEUS composes with them.
- Summarize checks as Passed, Action needed, or Blocked.
- Never invent proof IDs, check IDs, accounts, or URLs.
